intent: Generate an eMAG-ready square gallery suite with a stronger, cleaner version of the Excitat-style brand-frame structure.

slots.buyer_question: What is this product and why should I click it?
slots.image_job: product-preserving hero with brand frame, largest product, one primary proof point, and category palette

slots.buyer_question: What are the 3-5 most important benefits?
slots.image_job: product plus short icon/proof modules, avoiding paragraphs

slots.buyer_question: Which physical detail proves quality or function?
slots.image_job: macro detail or cutaway tied to a real visible part

slots.buyer_question: Will it fit my use case, device, size, or power requirement?
slots.image_job: dimensions, compatibility, power/capacity, or parameter strip around product
all included items arranged clearly with labels

slots.buyer_question: Where and how will I use it?
slots.image_job: realistic usage or scenario grid, one scene per panel

optional_slots.buyer_question: Why is this better than the weak alternative?
optional_slots.gate: Only use when comparison is factual and legally safe.

optional_slots.buyer_question: How do I install, assemble, or operate it?
optional_slots.gate: Use for tools, mounts, devices, and appliances where setup anxiety blocks purchase.

negative_constraints: Do not copy the Excitat logo or exact artwork.
Do not invent certifications, language, specs, package contents, or compatibility.
Do not generate final marketplace text inside the image model; reserve zones and render text deterministically.
Do not reuse one visual claim across multiple slots.
Do not make the product smaller than the proof text on the hero card.
